title: Where the inequality holds

prereqs.why: The set asked for is exactly an open ball on the real line, written as an interval.

statement:
Give the set of real numbers $x$ satisfying

$$|x - 2| < 3.$$

Write it as an interval. Use a round bracket for an endpoint that is excluded and a square bracket for one that is included.
hints: Read the expression as a distance: $|x - 2|$ is how far $x$ is from 2. The condition is a statement about that distance.
